title: JRE 2382 - Andrew Santino
guestBio: Andrew Santino is a comic, actor, and host of the podcasts "Whiskey Ginger," "No Bad Lies," and "Bad Friends" with comic Bobby Lee. Check out his new special, "Andrew Santino: White Noise," now streaming on Hulu.
tldr: Andrew Santino discusses his new special 'White Noise' on Hulu and what went into creating it
Conversation covers his podcast empire including 'Bad Friends' with Bobby Lee and 'Whiskey Ginger'
Andrew talks about his acting work and how comedy and acting inform each other
Discussion of his comedy style, approach to material, and evolution as a performer
Andrew shares stories from his life and experiences in the entertainment industry
Joe and Andrew discuss various aspects of stand-up comedy and the podcast landscape
recap:
Andrew Santino stops by JRE 2382 to talk about his bustling career in comedy and entertainment. The episode centers around his new special 'White Noise' now streaming on Hulu, which represents his latest work as a stand-up comedian. Andrew has built an impressive portfolio across multiple platforms, from his successful podcasts to his acting roles, and the conversation explores how these different avenues inform and support each other.

During the episode, Andrew discusses the creative process behind his special and what he wanted to accomplish with 'White Noise'. He talks about his approach to crafting comedy material and how he's evolved as a performer over the years. The conversation naturally flows into discussions about his podcast work, particularly 'Bad Friends' with Bobby Lee, which has become a popular show in the comedy podcast space. Andrew also mentions his other podcasts 'Whiskey Ginger' and 'No Bad Lies', explaining how he manages to juggle multiple creative projects.

The discussion touches on the entertainment industry more broadly, with Andrew sharing insights and stories from his experiences as both a comedian and actor. Joe and Andrew explore what makes comedy work, the importance of authenticity in stand-up, and how the podcast medium has changed the landscape for comedians. Throughout the episode, there's a natural chemistry between the two, with plenty of laughs and genuine moments of connection.
